INSERT INTO ship_transfers (
                    ship_symbol,
                    state,
                    fleet_id,
                    assignment_id,
                    start_system_symbol,
                    end_system_symbol,
                    reservation_id
                )
                SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
                    $1::character varying[],
                    $2::ship_transfer_state[],
                    $3::integer[],
                    $4::bigint[],
                    $5::character varying[],
                    $6::character varying[],
                    $7::bigint[]
                )
